name: rebate-statement
title: Rebate statement
for_each: select s.id, a.name||' '||s.period_start as name from settlements s join agreements g on g.id=s.agreement_id join accounts a on a.id=g.account_id order by s.period_start

sections.title: Agreement
sections.sql: select a.name as customer, g.name as agreement, s.period_start, s.period_end, case a.country when 'AU' then 'AUD' else 'NZD' end as currency from settlements s join agreements g on g.id=s.agreement_id join accounts a on a.id=g.account_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Qualifying sales by product
sections.sql: select p.code, p.name, sum(x.units) as units, sum(x.net_value) as net_sales from settlements s join agreements g on g.id=s.agreement_id join sales x on x.invoice_date between s.period_start and s.period_end join accounts a on a.id=x.account_id join products p on p.id=x.product_id where s.id=$1 and (x.account_id=g.account_id or a.parent_id=g.account_id) and (g.category is null or lower(p.category)=lower(g.category)) group by p.code, p.name order by p.code

sections.title: Calculation
sections.sql: select measure as qualifying, rate, calculated, adjustment, adjustment_reason, total as rebate_due, state, payment_ref, credit_note_ref from settlements where id=$1

name: agreement-schedule
title: Rebate agreement schedule
for_each: select g.id, g.name from agreements g where g.state<>'draft' order by g.name

sections.title: Terms
sections.sql: select a.name as customer, g.kind, g.rate_type, g.period, g.starts, g.ends, g.category, g.baseline, g.settle_within_days, g.settlement_method, g.signed_document from agreements g join accounts a on a.id=g.account_id where g.id=$1

sections.title: Tiers
sections.sql: select threshold, rate from rebate_tiers where agreement_id=$1 order by threshold

sections.title: This period
sections.sql: select period_start, period_end, measure, rate, earned_to_date, next_threshold, gap_to_next from tier_progress where id=$1

sections.title: Settlements
sections.sql: select period_start, period_end, total, state, paid_on, payment_ref from settlements where agreement_id=$1 order by period_start
